summary_en: Arealink Co., Ltd. (8914) has initiated a tender offer for all issued shares of Storage King Co., Ltd. (ticker 2997), a storage facility operator with approximately 13,000 units across Tokyo and three neighboring prefectures. The acquisition is positioned as a key growth initiative to reach 200,000-unit operational capacity by 2029 through leveraging big data, customer acquisition, and operational expertise to strengthen group synergies and enterprise value.
summary_jp: エリアリンクがストレージ王（2997）の公開買付けを開始。同社は首都圏中心に約13,000室を運営。買収は2029年までの20万室運営目標達成に向けた重要な成長施策。ビッグデータ・集客力・運営ノウハウでグループシナジーを早期実現し企業価値向上を図る。

summary_en: Arealink to acquire all ordinary shares of Storage King (TSE Growth) at ¥1,340/share, minimum 1,291,700 shares (¥1.73B). Tender period 9 Jul–21 Aug 2026 (30 business days). Warrants at ¥550,000 (Series 1) and ¥350,000 (Series 2). Target board recommends acceptance. Purpose: complete subsidiary acquisition. Six major shareholders (38.22% stake) have agreed to tender.
summary_jp: エリアリンク、ストレージ王普通株式をすべて取得：1,340円/株、最低1,291,700株（173億円）。応募期間2026年7月9日～8月21日（30営業日）。新株予約権は550,000円（第1回）・350,000円（第2回）。対象会社は応募推奨。目的：完全子会社化。大株主6社（38.22%保有）が応募合意済み。
